title: KSE-Web：低资源高棉语语义搜索的混合检索与LLM辅助查询扩展分析
summary: 本文针对低资源高棉语检索挑战，构建了约3000篇文档和300条人工审核查询的数据集，评估了字符n-gram BM25、多语言稠密检索、混合检索及LLM辅助查询扩展。结果显示BM25性能最佳（Recall 0.943，nDCG 0.876），混合检索相当，稠密检索较弱，LLM扩展未超越非扩展，但更大模型效果更好。
summary_en: This paper addresses low-resource Khmer retrieval, building a dataset of ~3K documents and 300 queries, and evaluates BM25, dense, hybrid, and LLM-assisted query expansion. BM25 performs best (Recall 0.943, nDCG 0.876), hybrid is comparable, dense is weaker, and LLM expansion doesn't outperform, though larger models help.
